requirement_understanding: The Sulzer Changeover module within the Ambica application enables production planners and master data managers to configure baseline duration standards (formatted as DD:HH:MM:SS) for various loom changeover processes including Knotting, FC Knotting, and Threading. Accurate duration settings are crucial for precise production scheduling and loom efficiency calculations.
requirement_gaps: Lack of explicit client-side input validation regex pattern for DD:HH:MM:SS before triggering backend submission.
No confirmation dialog when switching between changeover tabs (Knotting, FC Knotting, Threading) with unsaved duration entries.
Undocumented behavior regarding maximum allowable Days (DD) parameter value limit.
business_rules: Duration field must strictly adhere to the DD:HH:MM:SS format where DD=00-99, HH=00-23, MM=00-59, SS=00-59.
Each changeover category (Knotting, FC Knotting, Threading) maintains independent duration values.
Refreshing the view resets uncommitted duration changes back to the last persisted state.
Saving persists the configuration for the active changeover category across the enterprise setup.
assumptions: User possesses Master Data Management read/write permissions.
The application is pre-configured with Sulzer loom type parameters.
The testing environment is isolated from production scheduling engines.
risks: Malformed duration values saved to the database could disrupt downstream automated production scheduling algorithms.
Lack of dirty-form check could lead to accidental loss of configured changeover baseline metrics.

test_strategy.objectives: Verify end-to-end functionality, input format compliance, tab switching integrity, and persistence for Sulzer Changeover metrics across all process categories.
test_strategy.scope_in: Navigation, Refresh, Save actions, DD:HH:MM:SS format validation (positive, negative, boundary), tab switching across Knotting, FC Knotting, Threading.
test_strategy.scope_out: Downstream schedule generation logic, loom IoT telemetry integrations, identity authentication flows.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute automated database script to restore default benchmark duration values in the sulzer_changeover master table post-execution.

test_scenarios: Verify navigation to Sulzer Changeover section via Master Data menu.
Verify updating valid duration baseline for Knotting tab.
Verify updating valid duration baseline for FC Knotting tab.
Verify updating valid duration baseline for Threading tab.
Verify boundary input (99:23:59:59) on duration input field.
Verify lower boundary input (00:00:00:00) on duration input field.
Verify negative case: Invalid Hours value (>23) in duration field.
Verify negative case: Invalid Minutes value (>59) in duration field.
Verify negative case: Invalid Seconds value (>59) in duration field.
Verify negative case: Non-numeric alphabetic input in duration field.
Verify negative case: Blank/Empty submission in duration field.
Verify Refresh action discards unsaved modification in duration input field.
Verify tab navigation state retention between Knotting, FC Knotting, and Threading.

from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_sulzer_changeover(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/master-data/sulzer-changeover')
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("Sulzer Changeover")')
    page.click('button:has-text("FC Knotting")')
    page.click('input[placeholder="DD:HH:MM:SS"]')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="DD:HH:MM:SS"]', '00:00:00:12')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')
    page.click('button:has-text("Threading")')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="DD:HH:MM:SS"]', '12:12:12:12')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')

# Sulzer Changeover Module Test Matrix

## Overview
The Sulzer Changeover module manages operational process duration baselines across Knotting, FC Knotting, and Threading procedures.

## Core Workflows
1. Navigation from Master Data menu.
2. Selecting category tab (Knotting, FC Knotting, Threading).
3. Inputting DD:HH:MM:SS duration string.
4. Saving/Refreshing changes.
